answer_card.title: Push a custom execution environment to automation hub
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
podman run <user>/new-ee ansible-doc -l kubernetes.core   # verify
podman tag <user>/new-ee <hub>/<user>/new-ee
podman login -u=<user> -p=<token> <hub>
podman push <hub>/<user>/new-ee
```
Then in controller: **Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Execution Environments > Add**. Pushing needs admin or container repository permissions; use a registry credential if the hub is protected.
